notes:
Customizable Home: click ⚙ Customize Home…

Boxes: quick look-up (a person or a Chromebook), recently viewed, favorites, quick actions, waiting for approval, my open tickets, my notes, my links, background jobs, the numbers, the scorecard, what’s new and getting started.
Choices: turn each box on or off and set its order; pick your quick-action buttons and number tiles; add your own links (Admin console, help desk, SIS, a shared folder).
Defaults: each person’s layout is saved on their PC. Admins start with the full district view; techs start with a layout built around helping people (look-up, recent, favorites, quick actions, tickets, notes). “Reset to the default” puts it back.

Sidebar

My pages: right-click a page and choose 📌 Pin to My pages (or press Ctrl+Shift+P). Pages you use most also appear there; you can turn that off from the right-click menu.
Folding: click a section heading (People, Devices…) to fold it; right-click to fold or unfold all.
Roles: people still only see the pages their role allows.

Everyday help

Tray and alerts: closing the window keeps GAMbit in the taskbar tray. You get a Windows alert when a long job finishes while you’re elsewhere, a background job fails, or a new approval arrives. Both can be turned off in Settings & Updates → Appearance and safety.
Recently viewed: shown on Home and at the top of the search box.
✅ Check everything (Student lookup, Staff card and Home’s look-up; Ctrl+Shift+C):
It checks suspended, password, sign-in, 2-Step Verification, license, org unit, custom fields and their Chromebook.
Each problem gets a fix button, plus Fix everything GAMbit can.
Ticket-first: in the Ticket queue, Work on it opens the person, runs the check, and can add what was found and fixed to the ticket.
🖨 Print card: name, email, an optional fresh temporary password, their Chromebook and a QR code for Google sign-in. Print it or save it as a PDF, two per page or one large.

Safety and trust

Show before → after…: change confirmations list each field as it is now and as it will be, read from Google first.
Weekly digest: now adds changes by each tech, failed background jobs, Chromebooks not seen, and licenses running low. For the license warning, enter what you bought under Licenses you bought… next to the digest setting.
🎓 Practice mode (top bar): changes to the test account and test org unit run for real, and everything else is a dry run. It needs a test org unit or test account set in Settings & Updates → Testing.

Polish

Text size: goes up to Huge; Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- change it on the fly.
High contrast: new option in Settings & Updates → Appearance.
Shortcuts: Shift+F1 or Ctrl+/ lists every shortcut.
What’s new: shows once after each update (Ctrl+Shift+N any time). Existing installs will see it once on first launch of this version.
Send feedback…: emails your note, with the problem report attached if you like. It asks once who looks after GAMbit and remembers.
